inheritanceAudit.judgment: Earlier r3 active gameplay is inherited only where the grade package integrity matches current3086 and unchanged body/AI/Host/chaos/search/tool/economy sources support it. P01 staged entry, old-v2 arithmetic, audio and changed pressed-dunes configuration are not inherited. The production owner independently confirmed this change scope. This is not all-source byte identity.

independentReviewMethod.receipts: Selected automated entries are checked for entry/return runId identity, current r3 package, collected records, extracted loot and settled base receipt. Manual successes use actual returned-save receipts plus normal frame/input observations.
independentReviewMethod.images: Directly reviewed B2 active-control frames and fibre-silt manual search/extract frames, six second-seed death frames, ivory medium visible guards, reversed-flow medium actual opponent/HP loss, cinder low search and shell-gel-delta severe deep search. This reviewer did not visually watch every frame of every automated run. The batch visual reviews remain separate supporting sources.
independentReviewMethod.mechanismScope: No inference of audio quality, first-sight fun or universal route safety from JSON or screenshots.

supplementalAttemptOutcomes.basis: Original fixed one-attempt second-seed batches: low/medium14 + severe15. Failed and empty outcomes remain in raw reports; none is relabelled as a successful full search-return.

interpretation.passed: Each current grade has one actually searched, extracted and base-settled return plus a different seed with a genuinely different route, failed search/pressure or death. Internal finite-sample gameplay admission only.
notClaimed: All attempts won or returned profit
interpretation.sourceOfRules: Original task two-seed contract, unchanged. The 8-second filter only rejects spawn-only probes; duration alone is never acceptance.
